item.title: Amtrak cancels 20 Acela, Northeast Regional, Keystone trains due to winter weather issues
item.description: Amtrak has canceled multiple Acela, Northeast Regional and Keystone Service trains Thursday and Friday due to winter weather-related equipment issues.

item.title: Michigan man gets decades in prison for targeted Bensalem arson attack
item.description: A Michigan man who drove across several states to set fire to a Bensalem home was sentenced to decades in prison Wednesday, after a judge described the attack as a "nightmare" for the victims.

item.title: West Philadelphia residents raise concerns over damaged hydrants after snow
item.description: West Philadelphia residents have noticed several fire hydrants in poor condition after recent snow and cold weather, causing some to worry that they would work as needed during a fire emergency.

item.title: Family, ACLU demand transparency after Cambodian American man dies in ICE custody in Philadelphia
item.description: Parady La, a longtime Philadelphia-area resident and father, died Jan. 9 at Thomas Jefferson University Hospital after being found unresponsive in his cell at the Federal Detention Center.

item.title: Camden firefighter dies after being trapped under ice on Delaware River: Officials
item.description: Camden is mourning the loss of a firefighter who was pulled from the Delaware River after being trapped underneath the ice on Thursday morning.

item.title: Police: Potentially linked break-ins reported in Abington Township
item.description: Police in Abington Township are warning residents to stay alert after two break-ins in the Rydal section last month, which investigators believe may be connected.

item.title: Center City bar Dirty Franks bans patrons under 25 after fake ID surge
item.description: Jody Sweitzer, co-owner of Dirty Franks, said the decision comes after a teenager tried to use a fake Pennsylvania license with a photo of a 24-year-old Ben Franklin on it.
